notes: Account overview: Argentum builds clinical summarization + triage workflows for hospitals. Very sensitive PHI — primary requirement is private VPC with strict data residency and customer-controlled KMS.
CISO quote (paraphrase): 'We will only proceed if logs, keys, and model artifacts can be kept in our tenancy and we have exportable audit trails.'
Vendor risk intake: security team runs a formal SIG/CAIQ -> vendor-risk committee. They expect completed SIG + CAIQ + evidence (SOC2 report, penetration test summary, encryption key flow diagrams).
KMS expectations: customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) with support for AWS KMS and HSM-backed CMKs; key rotation policy and emergency key revocation plan required.

Shared responsibility: customer expects clear split — Redwood manages runtime and model infra; customer retains control of VPC, networking, and KMS. Need explicit doc for responsibilities (networking, backups, log retention, incident response).
Data residency: primary production in eu-west-1 for EU customers; they want option to pin regions per workspace and proof of no egress outside selected regions.
Audit logging: requirement to stream audit logs to customer S3/GCS bucket; retention configurable to 7 years; need schema of events and examples.
use_case_requirements_summary: Workload: low-latency clinical assistant for nursing stations (chat) + nightly batch document embeddings for search. Mixed latency/throughput profile.
Targets: 95th percentile latency < 250ms for short-turn chat (50 token responses) when serving within VPC; embeddings batch throughput ~2k docs/hour for nightly job.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for enterprise features but want guidance on batching/quantization to lower costs for embeddings pipeline.
Model prefs: prefer open models vetted for medical use; fallback path required (smaller quantized variant) if primary model unavailable.
